    // The undirected-edge number of every corner: the rank of its naming corner
    // among all naming corners, so both halves of a twin pair agree.
    PolygonCornerEdges(twins: Array<CornerIndex>): Array<UndirectedEdgeIndex>
    {
        var n = twins.Count;
        var naming = n.MapRange(c => NamesItsEdge(twins, c));
        var rank = n.MapRange(c =>
            c.MapRange(d => naming[d] ? 1 : 0).Reduce(0, (acc, hit) => acc + hit));
        return n.MapRange(c => UndirectedEdgeIndex(naming[c] ? rank[c] : rank[twins[c].Value]));
    }

    // The number of undirected edges a corner-twin table implies: one per naming
    // corner.
    PolygonEdgeCount(twins: Array<CornerIndex>): Integer
        => twins.Count.MapRange(c => NamesItsEdge(twins, c) ? 1 : 0).Reduce(0, (acc, hit) => acc + hit);

    // Every corner whose own vertex is the given one. On a closed manifold these
    // correspond one-to-one with the edges at that vertex and with the faces
    // around it, which is what lets the vertex rules below read all three from one
    // scan.
    OutgoingCornersOfVertex(self: PolygonMesh3D, vertex: Integer): Array<CornerIndex>
        => self.CornerCount.MapRange(c => c).Reduce(Repeat(0, CornerIndex(0)),
            (acc, c) => self.Faces.Values[c].Value == vertex ? acc.Append(CornerIndex(c)) : acc);

    // Catmull-Clark's new point on one edge: the average of the two endpoints and
    // the two adjacent face centroids, or the midpoint on a boundary edge.
    CatmullClarkEdgePoint(self: PolygonMesh3D, faces: Array<FaceIndex>, destinations: Array<VertexIndex>,
                          twins: Array<CornerIndex>, corner: Integer): Point3D
    {
        var a = self.Positions[self.Faces.Values[corner].Value];
        var b = self.Positions[destinations[corner].Value];
        var near = self.FaceCentroid(faces[corner].Value);
        return twins[corner].IsNone
            ? a.Lerp(b, 0.5)
            : ((a.PositionVector + b.PositionVector + near.PositionVector
                + self.FaceCentroid(faces[twins[corner].Value].Value).PositionVector) * 0.25).ToPoint;
    }

    // Where an old vertex moves under Catmull-Clark: (F + 2R + (n - 3)P) / n, with
    // F the average of the adjacent face centroids, R the average of the incident
    // edge midpoints, and n the valence. A vertex of valence under three has no
    // rule and stays put.
    CatmullClarkVertexPoint(self: PolygonMesh3D, faces: Array<FaceIndex>, destinations: Array<VertexIndex>, v: Integer): Point3D
    {
        var p = self.Positions[v];
        var corners = self.OutgoingCornersOfVertex(v);
        var n = corners.Count;
        var faceAverage = corners.Map(c => self.FaceCentroid(faces[c.Value].Value)).AverageOfPoints;
        var edgeAverage = corners.Map(c => p.Lerp(self.Positions[destinations[c.Value].Value], 0.5)).AverageOfPoints;
        return n < 3
            ? p
            : ((faceAverage.PositionVector
                + edgeAverage.PositionVector * 2.0
                + p.PositionVector * (n - 3).ToNumber) * (1.0 / n.ToNumber)).ToPoint;
    }

    // The quadrilateral Catmull-Clark emits at one corner: the corner's own moved
    // vertex, the point on the edge leaving it, the face's own centroid, and the
    // point on the edge arriving at it. Keeps the original face's winding.
    // Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Winding, handedness, and normals.
    CatmullClarkCornerFace(self: PolygonMesh3D, edges: Array<UndirectedEdgeIndex>, vertexCount: Integer,
                           edgeCount: Integer, face: Integer, slot: Integer): Array<VertexIndex>
    {
        var arity = self.FaceArity(face);
        var here = self.FaceCorner(face, slot);
        var back = self.FaceCorner(face, slot + arity - 1);
        return [self.Faces.Values[here.Value],
                VertexIndex(vertexCount + edges[here.Value].Value),
                VertexIndex(vertexCount + edgeCount + face),
                VertexIndex(vertexCount + edges[back.Value].Value)];
    }

    // One level of Catmull-Clark subdivision. The new position array is the moved
    // old vertices, then one point per undirected edge, then one centroid per
    // face; every new face is a quadrilateral.
    CatmullClarkSubdivided(self: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
    {
        var faces = self.PolygonCornerFaces;
        var destinations = self.PolygonCornerDestinations;
        var twins = PolygonCornerTwins(self.Faces.Values, destinations);
        var edges = PolygonCornerEdges(twins);
        var edgeCount = PolygonEdgeCount(twins);
        var vertexCount = self.VertexCount;
        var moved = vertexCount.MapRange(v => self.CatmullClarkVertexPoint(faces, destinations, v));
        var inserted = self.CornerCount.MapRange(c => c).Reduce(Repeat(0, Point3D.Origin), (acc, c) =>
            NamesItsEdge(twins, c)
                ? acc.Append(self.CatmullClarkEdgePoint(faces, destinations, twins, c))
                : acc);
        return PolygonMeshOfFaces(
            moved.Concatenate(inserted).Concatenate(self.FaceCentroids),
            self.FaceCount.MapRange(f => f).FlatMap(f =>
                self.FaceArity(f).MapRange(s =>
                    self.CatmullClarkCornerFace(edges, vertexCount, edgeCount, f, s))));
    }

    // Doo-Sabin's new vertex at one corner: the average of the corner's own
    // position, the midpoints of the two face edges meeting there, and the face
    // centroid. For a quadrilateral this is the classic 9/16, 3/16, 3/16, 1/16
    // mask.
    DooSabinCornerPoint(self: PolygonMesh3D, faces: Array<FaceIndex>, destinations: Array<VertexIndex>, corner: Integer): Point3D
    {
        var face = faces[corner].Value;
        var arity = self.FaceArity(face);
        var slot = corner - self.Faces.Offsets[face];
        var back = self.FaceCorner(face, slot + arity - 1);
        var p = self.Positions[self.Faces.Values[corner].Value];
        var ahead = self.Positions[destinations[corner].Value];
        var behind = self.Positions[self.Faces.Values[back.Value].Value];
        return ((p.PositionVector * 2.0 + ahead.PositionVector + behind.PositionVector) * 0.25
                + self.FaceCentroid(face).PositionVector * 0.25).ToPoint;
    }

    // The quadrilateral Doo-Sabin emits along one undirected edge, named by its
    // lower corner. With the corner running u to v in the near face, its twin runs
    // v to u in the far face, and the ribbon between the two shrunken faces reads
    // counter-clockwise from OUTSIDE as: far-at-u, far-at-v, near-at-v, near-at-u.
    // Taking the near face first instead traces the same quadrilateral backwards
    // and inverts the result's normals.
    // Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Winding, handedness, and normals.
    DooSabinEdgeFace(nextCorners: Array<CornerIndex>, twins: Array<CornerIndex>, corner: Integer): Array<VertexIndex>
        => [VertexIndex(nextCorners[twins[corner].Value].Value),
            VertexIndex(twins[corner].Value),
            VertexIndex(nextCorners[corner].Value),
            VertexIndex(corner)];

    // One level of Doo-Sabin subdivision: one new vertex per corner, and three
    // families of new face — one shrunken copy of each original face, one
    // quadrilateral along each interior edge, and one face around each vertex.
    // The vertex faces take the REVERSED corner ring, because a face built around
    // a vertex winds opposite to the rotation that generated it.
    // Precondition: a closed manifold.
    DooSabinSubdivided(self: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
    {
        var faces = self.PolygonCornerFaces;
        var destinations = self.PolygonCornerDestinations;
        var nextCorners = self.PolygonNextCorners;
        var twins = PolygonCornerTwins(self.Faces.Values, destinations);
        var faceFaces = self.FaceCount.MapRange(f =>
            self.FaceArity(f).MapRange(s => VertexIndex(self.FaceCorner(f, s).Value)));
        var edgeFaces = self.CornerCount.MapRange(c => c)
            .Reduce(Repeat(0, Repeat(0, VertexIndex(0))), (acc, c) =>
                twins[c].IsPresent.And(c < twins[c].Value)
                    ? acc.Append(DooSabinEdgeFace(nextCorners, twins, c))
                    : acc);
        var vertexFaces = self.VertexCount.MapRange(v =>
            self.ReversedVertexCornerRing(VertexIndex(v)).Map(c => VertexIndex(c.Value)));
        return PolygonMeshOfFaces(
            self.CornerCount.MapRange(c => self.DooSabinCornerPoint(faces, destinations, c)),
            faceFaces.Concatenate(edgeFaces).Concatenate(vertexFaces));
    }
